text:
sara_marketing: Hey @mike_runtime and @jess_eng — prepping a short webinar demo + blog launch. We need a small set of validated benchmark artifacts from runtime to back up our claims. Can you help with a reproducible run and a quick sanity pack?

sara_marketing: Specifically asking for: 1) raw per-request traces (latency/token) for the seed cohort, 2) a heatmap of latency percentiles across sequence lengths, 3) the exact command/config used to produce the data, and 4) a tiny CSV mapping sample_id -> input prompt for provenance. Need these for the press pack and a slide. :pray:

mike_runtime: Got it. Quick q: which model variants do you want? baseline FP16 + int8 quantized? Also clarify seed cohort size — ~200 samples?

sara_marketing: Yes FP16 baseline + int8 quant. Seed cohort = 240 (stratified across short/medium/long contexts). We want the same seed across runs for reproducibility. Also need a warmup protocol description we used (how many warmup requests, sequence lengths).

jess_eng: We can produce traces but will need a short SLA window. If ops_bot can schedule a short job on dedicated-dev cluster for a couple hours we can run both variants and export traces. Can someone confirm schedule window?

alec_data: I can prepare the CSV of sample_id -> prompt. I'll stratify by context length buckets: <=128, 129-512, 513-2048. Will tag edge cases (long tail, many stops). Also include a tiny checklist of which prompts are deterministic vs stochastic.

ops_bot: deploy-job queued: job_id=deploy-2026-03-22-52, est runtime 45m. Add note in job description if you need GPU type pinning.

mike_runtime: Thanks @ops_bot. Our plan: 1) warmup 200 requests (mixed lengths) 2) run seed cohort 240 through FP16 variant, export traces to s3://redwood-marketing/bench/1758881234/fp16/ 3) same for int8 to s3://redwood-marketing/bench/1758881234/int8/ 4) produce heatmap PNG + percentile CSV (p50,p90,p99) per length bucket.

mike_runtime: Example command we'll run for reproducibility (we'll include exact git sha and docker image):
```
./run_bench.sh --model rwd-open-13b --variant fp16 --cohort-file cohorts/1758881234-seed.csv --warmup 200 --out s3://redwood-marketing/bench/1758881234/fp16/ --trace true --git-sha $(git rev-parse HEAD)
```

jess_eng: One note — for int8 we use a slightly different kernel path; latency tails can shift. We'll include kernel/config diffs in the artifact bundle. Also will annotate any samples where caching or prefix hits affected latencies.

sara_marketing: Amazing — can you also add a short README in the artifact bundle with: run timestamp, runtime image, GPU type, batch size distribution, and any anomalies you saw? We might call out a sample or two in the blog.

mike_runtime: Will do. Timeline: start now, expect artifacts + README + CSV + heatmaps in ~2.5h. If anything blocks we'll flag here.

alec_data: CSV skeleton done, uploading to cohorts/1758881234-seed.csv now. It includes sample_id, prompt_sha256, length_tokens, bucket_tag, deterministic_flag.

sara_marketing: Perfect — thanks everyone. Once artifacts are up I'll pull screenshots for the slide deck and ping legal for quote clearance. :clap:

mike_runtime: Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-marketing/bench/1758881234/fp16/ traces.csv, percentiles.csv, heatmap.png, README.md

mike_runtime: Also uploaded int8 set to s3://redwood-marketing/bench/1758881234/int8/ — note: 3 samples flagged where int8 generated small output truncation, annotated in README (these are expected regressions).

jess_eng: Quick sanity: p50 delta fp16->int8 = +3ms, p90 = +12ms, p99 = +40ms on long-tail bucket. We'll add a short note in README describing calibration and quantization profile used.

sara_marketing: This is exactly what we needed. Upload the public-friendly artifact bundle link when you have it and we'll wire it into the press deck. Leaving thread open for followups. :rocket:
